terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.accept: I have read and accept the terms
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use MISK to book home and garden services or to offer them as a pro. Please read them before you create an account.

about.title: 1. What MISK is
about.body: MISK is a marketplace that connects customers with independent professionals ("pros") for home and garden services. The pros are not employed by MISK; each pro is responsible for the work they do.

account.title: 2. Your account
account.body: Give your real name and an email address or mobile number you use. An email account can only sign in after you confirm your email address. Keep your password to yourself. We may pause or close an account that breaks these terms or is used to harm others.

booking.title: 3. Booking and prices
booking.body: The price you see before you book includes VAT and the MISK service fee. Your card is checked when you book, and charged 24 hours after the pro marks the job as done.

cancelling.title: 4. Cancelling
cancelling.body: You can cancel for free until 24 hours before the start. If you cancel later and a pro has already been assigned, the full price is charged and the pro is paid their share.

problems.title: 5. If something goes wrong
problems.body: Report a problem in the app within 24 hours after the job. The charge then waits until our team has looked at it. Depending on what happened, the team refunds you or charges the booking.

tips.title: 6. Tips
tips.body: Tips are optional and charged to the card you booked with. The pro receives the tip minus the same commission MISK keeps on jobs. A refund of a job does not refund a tip.

plans.title: 7. Monthly plans
plans.body: Plans are billed every month. You can cancel a plan in the app; it ends when the paid month ends, once its minimum term is over. Seasonal plans only run from April to October.

pros.title: 8. For pros
pros.body: Pros send their ID, trade certificate, insurance and a certificate of good conduct, and get jobs only once MISK has checked them and while they stay valid. MISK keeps a commission on each job and pays out the rest to your bank account.

liability.title: 9. Responsibility
liability.body: MISK is responsible for running the platform and handling payments with care. The pro who does the job is responsible for the quality and safety of the work. Nothing in these terms limits your rights as a consumer under the law.

changes.title: 10. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. If a change matters for you, we tell you in the app or by email before it applies.
